evidenceNotes: Initial real Manual 30/30 reached EC 30/30 and schema-v2 OWNED generation 3.
A subsequent 40/40 interaction first failed closed after ownership verification read a transient/non-owned 40/30 setpoint and production restore returned to Firmware.
A later successful 40/40 occurred only after a new Custom admission, so the original same-session generation-5 contract was no longer valid.
No P16 PASS, strong-restore PASS or evidence closure is claimed.

physicalAttemptHistory.failure: 8C40 EC-setpoint probe failed: Timed out waiting for Global\\Access_EC.
evidenceNotes: The normal GUI started in Firmware with Manual open only through the dedicated P16 gate and Automatic closed.
Initial 30/30 was independently proven as OWNED generation 3 in session ff46b809-0fb8-4e5a-bf06-93dbb54491ad after an earlier transient EC-mutex failure restored Firmware.
40/40 was independently proven as OWNED generation 5 in the same session/controller identity.
The real GUI logged the return 30/30 Apply as successful, but the parent independent EC probe then failed to acquire Global\\Access_EC within its single 500 ms acquisition window.
No return-30 parent proof, Firmware strong-restore proof, tray-exit proof or P16 PASS is claimed.

findings: AcpiEcReader retries EC protocol reads only after mutex acquisition; a Global\\Access_EC acquisition timeout is currently a single 500 ms terminal failure.
The independent P16 parent setpoint probe treats one transient Global\\Access_EC acquisition timeout as terminal instead of using a bounded whole-probe retry.

The P16 harness waits only for a later successful expected interaction and does not immediately abort when the same requested P13 Manual interaction logs FAILED CLOSED, allowing an invalid retry/new Custom session to satisfy a later success pattern.

The P16 authorization state was reusable for more than one physical harness invocation; the next design must make authorization operationally one-shot or otherwise explicitly fence a consumed attempt.
hardeningRequired.nextAction: Run full same-head CI on the syntax-corrected software-only hardening, then formally close the hardening with all gates still false before any fresh P16B authorization.
